parole.significato: alpha, the name for the first letter of the modern Greek alphabet.
parole.testo: Inherited from Ancient Greek ἄλφα (álpha), ultimately from Phoenician 𐤀𐤋𐤐 (ʾlp /⁠ʾālep⁠/, “bull, ox”).
